main.description: A comment on a video, written to the commenter's own repository; deleting the record removes the comment. Like other repository records it is public. Threads are one level deep: a reply points at the top-level comment it belongs to, and replying to a reply points at that same top-level comment.

subject.description: The social.openreel.video.post the comment is on, pinned to the version seen.

parent.description: The top-level social.openreel.video.comment on the same video that this replies to. Omitted for a top-level comment.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the comment was written.
